newsitem.title: USA: First Bank System Inc Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: First Bank System Inc Q1 net rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q1 1997 operating earnings before non-recurring items $171.8 million or $1.27 a share vs $160.1 million or $1.14 a share. Nonrecurring items added $0.12 to net income to Q1 1996 earnings.
Q1 1997 non-interest income $225.8 million vs $208.1 million and Q1 1997 net interest income $384.8 million vs $379.3 million, both before effect of non-recurring items.

Q1 net income applicable to common equity $171.8 million vs $175.1 million after items. Q1 1997 primary net income $1.27 on 135.5 million shares vs $1.28 on 137.0 million shares after items. Q1 fully diluted net income $1.27 on 135.5 million shares vs $1.26 on 140.7 million shares after items.
